dynamics.cart_force: M_cc * requested_cart_acceleration + M_ch * hinge_acceleration + bias_c - passive_c
dynamics.diagnostics: requested/applied force and achieved acceleration describe final completed physics substep; truth is post-step
dynamics.equation: M qacc + bias = passive + applied, no constraints or contacts
dynamics.expiry: checked at beginning of every physics tick; no active demand -> zero requested acceleration, possibly nonzero force
dynamics.force_clipping: cart generalized force only, [-max_force_n,+max_force_n]; hinge applied force remains zero
dynamics.integration: MuJoCo Euler with implicit damping disabled; physical passive damping still included in force solve
dynamics.numerical_failure: MuJoCo autoreset disabled; bad qpos/qvel/qacc warning or nonfinite result raises RuntimeError, requires reset

gym.action: Box(1,) acceleration m/s^2, malformed/out-of-bound values rejected
gym.observation: Dict state=[x,v,sin(theta),cos(theta),omega], valid=5-element mask, age_s=effective age; unknown -1

limitations: not calibrated or validated against hardware
no motor dynamics, backlash, rail contact or physical emergency stop model
Gaussian noise is not a measured sensor-error model
model: uniform slender rod, cart +x slider, unactuated +y hinge, zero angle upright +z

cart_rotational_inertia_kg_m2.basis: arbitrary positive inertia, no cart rotation DOFs

effective_length_m.basis: saved settings leff; archived comment describes prior low-angle cycles, not current model validation

max_force_n.basis: assumed symmetric cart-force limit, not measured motor authority

pole_axial_inertia.basis: transverse inertia times 1e-6 to satisfy positive inertia; no effect on sole +y hinge

pole_mass_kg.basis: archived comment 11.05 g arm plus two 5.85 g weights, unconfirmed for actual rig

rod_length_m.basis: surrogate derivation l=1.5*L_eff; not actual geometric arm length

sensors.clock: integer physics tick clock; t=0 acquisition included
sensors.delay: physics tick queue, initial unknown until first delivery
sensors.dropout: one seeded Bernoulli draw per acquisition shared by all channels, explicit invalid values None
sensors.held_samples: retain original acquisition, effective and receipt timestamps; observation availability advances
sensors.noise: independent Gaussian channel noise with configured standard deviations; angle wrapped atan2(sin,cos)

status: provisional unvalidated surrogate; no measured full rigid-body or motor identification
